module_title: Language Policy, Assessment Reforms (PARAKH) & Teacher Education
introduction: This intermediate tier explores the radical changes NEP 2020 brings to evaluation, language of instruction, and teacher qualifications. It introduces PARAKH, the 360-degree report card, and the pedagogical mandates for teachers.

core_concepts.title: Language and Multilingualism
core_concepts.description:
NEP 2020 strongly advocates for Multilingualism as a cognitive asset.
- Medium of Instruction: Wherever possible, the medium of instruction until at least Grade 5 (and preferably till Grade 8 and beyond) must be the **Mother tongue/Home language/Local language**.
- Three-Language Formula: Retained from earlier policies, but implemented flexibly. No language will be imposed on any State. At least two of the three languages chosen must be native to India.

core_concepts.title: Assessment Reforms & PARAKH
core_concepts.description:
NEP mandates a shift from summative (rote-based) to formative (competency-based) assessment.
- PARAKH: (Performance Assessment, Review, and Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic Development). A new National Assessment Centre established under NCERT as a standard-setting body to guide all school boards.
- 360-Degree Holistic Progress Card (HPC): The traditional report card is replaced by the HPC. It assesses the child across Cognitive, Affective, and Psychomotor domains using Triangulation: Self-assessment, Peer-assessment, and Teacher-assessment.

core_concepts.title: NCF-SE 2023: The Panchakosha Vikas
core_concepts.description:
NCF 2023 bases holistic education on the ancient Indian 'Panchakosha' model (Five Sheaths of human existence):
1. Annamaya Kosha (Physical development)
2. Pranamaya Kosha (Life energy / Breath)
3. Manomaya Kosha (Mind / Emotional development)
4. Vijnanamaya Kosha (Intellectual / Cognitive development)
5. Anandamaya Kosha (Spiritual / Bliss)

core_concepts.title: Teacher Education & CPD
core_concepts.description:
To elevate the teaching profession, NEP 2020 introduces massive structural changes:
- Qualification: By 2030, the minimum degree qualification for teaching will be a **4-year integrated B.Ed. degree**.
- Continuous Professional Development (CPD): Every teacher and principal is mandated to participate in at least **50 hours** of CPD opportunities every year.

important_entities.name: 10 Bagless Days
important_entities.key_fact: A mandate for the Middle Stage (Grades 6-8).
important_entities.significance: To foster dignity of labor and vocational integration, students will participate in a 10-day bagless period where they intern with local vocational experts (carpenters, gardeners, potters, artists). It is a direct application of John Dewey's 'Learning by Doing' and Constructivism.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Examiners will try to trick you by stating: 'NEP 2020 makes Hindi compulsory in all schools.' This is **FALSE**. NEP 2020 explicitly states that NO language is being imposed on any state. The 3-language formula is entirely flexible based on the state's and student's choice.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Performance Assessment, Review, Analysis (of) Knowledge (for) Holistic (development)
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Break it down: PAR (Performance Assessment Review) + AKH (Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic).

exam_strategy_tips: Whenever you see '360-degree', match it with 'Holistic Progress Card (HPC)'. If the question asks what replaces the 'summative, rote-learning board exams', the answer is 'Competency-Based Evaluation (CBE)' via PARAKH.
